priorityList: Maintain Arcane Intellect and ensure your Water Elemental is summoned.
Cast Blizzard immediately whenever Freezing Rain is active (instant cast).
Cast Glacial Spike if you have 5 Icicles.
Cast Blizzard as a priority filler to maintain its ground effect and cooldown reduction on Frozen Orb.
Cast Flurry when Brain Freeze is active to apply Winter's Chill and shatter your next spells.
Cast Ice Lance if you have Fingers of Frost procs.
Cast Ice Lance if the target has 10 or more stacks of the Freezing debuff to consume the shatter bonus.
Cast Ray of Frost, but avoid using it if you currently have a Frostfire Empowerment buff active.
Use offensive cooldowns (Trinkets, Potions, and Racials) during Frozen Orb or Ray of Frost windows.
Cast Frostfire Bolt as your primary filler to generate Icicles and procs.
If moving, use Blink for distance or Ice Nova/Ice Lance if no procs are available.
Cast Ice Lance as a final priority if the target is about to die.
